title: Accounting and Tax Services for Immigrants With Foreign Assets

rows.before: Where a company is put in place, section 125 brings the combined Ontario rate on the first $500,000 of active business income down to about 12.2%, and what follows from that rate is planned before the first year ends.
rows.after: Where a company is put in place, section 125 brings the combined Ontario rate on the first $500,000 of active business income down to about 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), and what follows from that rate is planned before the first year ends.
rows.note: First R1 change on page; parenthetical added.
